title: Role Gap in Privileged MFA Override Authorization
description: Tests discovery of authorization role gaps where front-line support staff are permitted to override critical security credentials without a defined gate to enforce mandatory secondary InfoSec approval.

expectedRequirements.statementPattern: .*Tier 1 Support Agents may override customer MFA credentials.*
.*secondary approval from an Information Security Officer.*

expectedFindings.rationale: Tier 1 Support Agents are authorized to perform MFA credential overrides upon verbal verification, with no mechanism or boundary enforcing the mandated Information Security Officer secondary approval.
